meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 它会按 6 个步骤带你在一台已有的 AKS 集群上搭好 AI Runway：检查集群与 GPU、安装 controller、评估 GPU 限制、选配推理 provider、部署并验证第一个模型。每步先报告状态，安装或部署前先征求你确认。
howto.when: 当你提到「setup AI Runway」「airunway setup」「deploy model to AKS」等关键词，或要求装 controller、跑 AKS 上的 GPU 推理时接管。前提是集群已存在，没有集群会先转给 azure-kubernetes。

say.text: 帮我在这个 AKS 集群上安装 AI Runway controller
say.note: 先核对集群状态，再装 CRD 和 controller

say.text: 评估一下我这台集群的 GPU，能跑哪些模型
say.note: 检测 GPU 型号并标出 dtype 等限制

say.text: 从第 3 步开始继续 AI Runway 的安装
say.note: 按 skip-to-step 从指定步骤恢复

howto.what_en: It walks you through six steps to set up AI Runway on an existing AKS cluster: verify the cluster and GPUs, install the controller, assess GPU limits, pick an inference provider, then deploy and verify your first model. It reports status each step and confirms before installing.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to set up AI Runway, install its controller, deploy a model or run GPU inference on AKS. The cluster must already exist; otherwise it hands off to azure-kubernetes first.

say_en.text: Install the AI Runway controller on this AKS cluster
say_en.note: Checks cluster state, then installs CRDs and controller

say_en.text: Assess the GPUs on my cluster and what models they can run
say_en.note: Detects GPU models and flags dtype limits

say_en.text: Resume the AI Runway setup from step 3
say_en.note: Starts at that step via skip-to-step
